resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Spanish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Spanish pass identified 25 actionable defects in battery summaries, evidence notes, and safety wording; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Spanish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary was awkwardly phrased.
evidence: The previous Spanish wording used an unnecessary literal construction for a rechargeable cell.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a concise description of a removable rechargeable cell for compatible devices.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary did not clearly distinguish an internal pack from a replaceable cell.
evidence: The previous wording described an internal battery but did not clearly state that it is integrated.
findings.resolution: Added the integrated-pack and user-replaceable-cell distinction.

findings.summary: The approval note used a feminine adjective without a clear feminine antecedent.
evidence: The previous text began with ‘Aprobada’ although the implied record is masculine.
findings.resolution: Changed the agreement to the natural masculine form ‘Aprobado’.

findings.summary: The capacity note used less precise label language.
evidence: The previous wording said the capacity was lower than what the label suggests rather than lower than the labeled value.
findings.resolution: Changed it to state that true capacity is below the capacity shown on the label.

findings.summary: The 20 A continuous-rating note was not grammatical Spanish.
evidence: The previous text placed the number before a malformed literal translation of continuous rating.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 20 A of continuous current and explicitly excluded pulse values.

findings.summary: The comparison note was a malformed machine translation of the source sentence.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Un’ and awkward word order around the wrapper and production revision.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the value as a conservative independent 20 A comparison and retained both qualifiers.

findings.summary: The exact-model testing note had malformed number placement and unnatural phrasing.
evidence: The previous text used ‘15 Un valor’ and did not naturally connect the tested CCC-marked revision.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 15 A value from exact-model testing.

findings.summary: The tabless-revision note mistranslated the tested-cell description.
evidence: The previous wording referred to a revision without tabs as ‘sin tablas’ and used malformed amperage grammar.
findings.resolution: Used the technical term ‘tabless’ and explicitly warned not to substitute pulse values.

findings.summary: The true-continuous-value note was not grammatical Spanish.
evidence: The previous text used ‘36 Un verdadero valor continuo’ and omitted natural temperature wording.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 36 A true continuous value with the 56 A figure temperature-limited.

findings.summary: The pre-production and CCC caveat used awkward literal wording.
evidence: The previous text used an unnecessary capitalized sentence fragment and a less natural term for tested cells.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 40 A value for tested pre-production cells without the CCC logo.

findings.summary: The recommended continuous value note was malformed and unclear about cycle life.
evidence: The previous text used ‘13 Un valor’ and a literal phrase for the intended cycle-life limitation.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a recommended 13 A continuous value and an absolute 16.8 A maximum.

findings.summary: The note had malformed amperage grammar and an unnatural temperature caveat.
evidence: The previous text said ‘40 Un valor’ and used ‘temperatura limitada’ as a literal fragment.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 40 A value with temperature-limited 70 A and pre-production samples.

findings.summary: The production-cell comparison note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Un valor comparativo’ and did not naturally state the temperature requirement.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 40 A production-cell comparison value requiring temperature control at 70 A.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper note was malformed and used an unclear translation of rewrap.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Un’ and ‘reenvoltorio’ in an otherwise ungrammatical sentence.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 40 A exact-wrapper value limited to 60 °C and tested as an EVE 40PL rewrap.

findings.summary: The 19 A evidence note had malformed number placement.
evidence: The previous text used ‘19 Un valor’ and unnatural capitalization around the tested samples.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 19 A value for pre-production samples without CCC marks.

findings.summary: The 40 A and 90 A caveat was not grammatical Spanish.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Un valor’ and the literal fragment ‘tiene una temperatura limitada’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 40 A value with temperature-limited 90 A.

findings.summary: The temperature and unresolved-production caveat was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Un’ and a literal phrase for temperature limitation and production continuity.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 40 A value with temperature-limited 60 A and unresolved production continuity.

findings.summary: The capacity and marking caveat used awkward phrasing.
evidence: The previous text used ‘40 Un’ and the unnatural phrase ‘capacidad inconsistente’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 40 A value for tested samples with irregular capacity and missing marks.

findings.summary: The 13 A evidence note had malformed number placement and capitalization.
evidence: The previous text used ‘13 Un valor’ and an unnatural sentence structure.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a conservative 13 A value for pre-production samples without CCC marks.

findings.summary: The tester estimate note was malformed and used an unnatural temperature phrase.
evidence: The previous text used ‘30 Un valor continuo’ and ‘tiene una temperatura limitada’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a tester-estimated 30 A continuous value with Reliance's 50 A maximum temperature-limited.

findings.summary: The two-batch production note was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Un valor’ and a literal construction for temperature limitation.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 20 A continuous value from two tested production-related batches.

findings.summary: The continuous-versus-pulse distinction used awkward technical Spanish.
evidence: The previous text was understandable but used an unnatural phrase for pulse-only current.
findings.resolution: Clarified 12 A continuous, 20 A pulse-only, and preserved the exact wrapper identifier.

findings.summary: The exact-wrapper and sourcing caveat contained malformed number placement and literal terms.
evidence: The previous text used ‘20 Un’ and awkward translations for wrapper revisions and sourcing.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the 20 A exact-wrapper value, tester recommendation, advertisement, and sourcing caveat.

findings.summary: The rewrap note was malformed and used an unclear literal translation.
evidence: The previous text used ‘30 Un’ and an unnatural term for rewrap.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as a 30 A exact-model value and identified it as a rewrap.

findings.summary: The revision-specific inheritance warning was malformed.
evidence: The previous text used ‘30 Un’ and awkwardly described the materially different four-leg revisions.
findings.resolution: Rephrased the exact five-leg revision value and the warning against inheriting the profile.
